name: Recurring repair service history
summary: When repeated maintenance keeps disturbing guests, the facilities manager gets one brief by equipment and room area: repeated work orders, confirmed service interruptions and missing inspection records side by side. It finds no cause and orders no work.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own published map of hospitality property upkeep, and its own rules for prepared work: the property's records as the only authority, set column headings with a stop on a mismatch, a repeat counted by fixed rules, every gap written as a question for a named role, and a person who investigates and decides.
